title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a change to a user's credential ends every other outstanding password-reset token of that user
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a password write through either of this plugin's storage adapters (the factory `AuthManager` composes, and the exported raw `createObjectQLAdapter`) ends every other password-reset link and texted reset code still outstanding for that user, in the same request and before the new password is written. In the `AuthManager` composition that is every door that sets a password: a completed reset (`POST /reset-password`, `POST /phone-number/reset-password`), the user's own `POST /change-password`, an administrator's `POST /admin/set-user-password`, and a first password (`POST /set-initial-password`). No request, response or metadata shape is added, removed or re-shaped; a link or code requested after the change resets as usual.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` states the rule; no skill under `skills/**` teaches the reset doors.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:用户的密码只要经本插件的存储适配器被写入(完成重置、本人改密、管理员设密、首次设密,以及导出的原始 `createObjectQLAdapter`),该用户此前发出、尚未使用的其他重置链接和短信重置码一律作废;改动之后再申请的链接/验证码照常可用。
- 为什么改:安全加固,规则是「凭据一变,之前的重置凭证全部失效」。
- 风险与回滚:每次写密码多一次读和一两次按条件删除(配置了二级缓存时先读后按 id 删);作废失败、缓存键无法确定、或部署把验证标识存成非明文时,这次写密码直接报错、旧密码不变(宁可失败,不留活凭证)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.ts`(规则、两条删除路径与三种拒绝)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts` 中工厂适配器与原始适配器的 create / update / updateMany 接线(均在写入之前)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts`,预期 17/17 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule** — `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.ts` (new): a change to a user's credential ends every other outstanding password-reset token of that user — the emailed reset links and the texted reset code for the phone number the user holds — and, with a host `secondaryStorage` in the `AuthManager` composition, their cached copies. An ended token answers exactly what a token never issued answers. With no cache, each token shape is ended by one predicate delete; with a cache, the links are read first so each cached copy can be named, and exactly those rows are deleted. A password write is refused, and the old password stands, when its tokens cannot be ended, when a cached link's key cannot be named, when the verification store keeps identifiers other than plain (`verification.storeIdentifier`), or when the account row it targets names no user.
- **The wiring** — `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts`: both storage adapters call the rule for every `sys_account` write that carries `password`, before the write lands: the factory `AuthManager` composes (`create`, `update`, `updateMany`) and the exported raw `createObjectQLAdapter` (the same three verbs). The raw adapter is handed none of better-auth's options, so through it the rule covers the token rows only; a host that pairs it with a `secondaryStorage` or a `verification.storeIdentifier` setting is outside the rule.
- **Docs** — `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` states the rule beside the reset section.
- **Census** — the tenant-audit census is regenerated over current `main` for this change's three engine write sites (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`); `main`'s census is now sharded per package, so the only moved artefact is the plugin-auth shard (`docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts/plugins/plugin-auth.md`): write call sites 95 → 98, object name chosen at run time 37 → 40, other run-time expression 35 → 38, provably carrying no context 12 → 15, readable engine type 69 → 72; repository total 325.
- **Changeset** — `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, BREAKING narrowing, ADR-0087 `not-required`; it scopes the rule to the two storage adapters and states what the raw one does not cover.

The eight plugin-auth files held by #34333 are untouched.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts` — every door through the real routes (a real `AuthManager` over a real `ObjectQL` engine on better-sqlite3, behind `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` on a Hono app):

- a completed reset ends the user's other reset links, whichever was spent first; the ended link answers what a never-issued link answers, at `POST /reset-password` and at its landing (`GET /reset-password/:token`); the password is the one the spent link set;
- `POST /change-password`, `POST /admin/set-user-password` (for a user with a local password and for one without) and `POST /set-initial-password` each end every link outstanding before them; a link requested afterwards resets (the control);
- a password write through the exported `createObjectQLAdapter` ends the holder's earlier link;
- a password change ends the outstanding texted reset code (it answers what a never-sent code answers); a code requested afterwards resets; a completed texted-code reset ends the outstanding links;
- another user's links are untouched (the control);
- with a `secondaryStorage` cache, an ended link's and an ended texted code's cached copies are gone, and the link answers what a never-issued link answers;
- a password write does not land — the old password stands and the outstanding link resets — when a token delete fails, and when a cached link's key cannot be named;
- the composed verification store carries no identifier-storage setting (a closed key set, with and without a cache); a password write under a setting other than plain is refused, and so is one whose target names no user.

## Acceptance notes

- None beyond the scope stated in the changeset.
